note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (tracked by PSNProfiles and Exophase). Every guide below is written in my own words for this guide; sources are cited beside each guide and never copied.

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly: follow the roadmap, finish the story, work the 100% checklist, and mop up the side quests. Budget around 200 hours for the whole run; PowerPyx rates the set 4 out of 10 in difficulty, with A Long Road as the real gate.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops at the end of the mission. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 1; it unlocks as Chapter 2 opens with its first mission. Play through the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 2; it pops when Chapter 3 begins. Story only, no side work needed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 3; it unlocks as Chapter 4 gets going. Story only.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 4; it pops at the end of the chapter's final mission. Story only.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the final story mission and this gold pops with the credits. It is the last story trophy; everything after it is free-roam cleanup toward the platinum.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission, so just play the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. Story only, cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Story only.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Story only.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. Story only.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — the last mission-linked bronze.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the real platinum gate. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work the checklist. It is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion: scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars, finish any 70 of the 80 challenges, and clear the robbery, shooting-range, drone-race and Bret quest lines. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix categories freely — under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track them under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most happen naturally while chasing other trophies; the story introduces most of them for you.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Each range has its own set of challenges; the golds are forgiving and need no perfect run. Work through the ranges after the story, one at a time, and check progress at each range.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 races in total. Each location hosts several races; winning one race per location is what counts for the trophy, though the 100% checklist wants more. Fly the drone courses after the story when you can move freely.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Any race type counts; each location only counts once, so keep moving to new spots instead of replaying one. The map marks race starts once you unfog an area.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. The questline stays open after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all its levels at least once. There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade machines around the world. Pick the one you enjoy most; beating every challenge inside it is not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Complete all five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. The whole line stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls and marks his shop in Key Lento with a green KR icon. He sends you treasure-diving for 7 shipwrecks: follow the purple chest markers, use the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring each haul back. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. He goes quiet during parts of the story but always comes back, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last. All of it stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers around Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Andy, Billy, Moses, Tyrone and Yasmani do not. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (package deliveries), with more still being found. Every strand stays available in free-roam after the story, so work them after the credits. Watch the trophy tracker for your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against his list, and deliver them in good condition for better pay. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. It all stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go in and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs fall, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. That balcony session vanishes once Chapter 1 ends. Do it the moment it appears, and keep a manual save at the start of the chapter as insurance. The final spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County — it is Jason-only. After the first hunt he marks more hunting spots with purple icons; bring each requested animal back to him. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle on the first quest. One clean shot keeps a carcass pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track progress under Map, Activities, Target Deck.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets from the 18 sets hidden around Leonida. Cards turn up while exploring — check your sets under Progress, Collections, and chase the sets nearest completion first. You do not need all 18 sets, just any three.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1, while looking at landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, so scan whatever you pass — busy streets and tourist spots fill the counter fast. The same scanning habit also feeds the vehicle-discovery trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress, Challenges, where each one shows a checkmark when done. Most complete themselves while you chase other trophies; the 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there. When it is nearly done, pick the easiest remaining challenges rather than the hardest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Cause enough chaos to reach 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone — a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route since helicopters cannot follow you there. If you miss it early, the big bank-vault robberies later in the game hand you 4-star wanted levels for free.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner first, then hit three robbery targets (green map icons) while the red and blue wanted level stays flashing — never let it drop. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. A good run is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; loot properly in each, including the back-room safe. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop — if it does not fire, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — scanning is enough, you never have to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles in the game; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops early on the way there. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and line up five enemies before you trigger it; an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 helps. Note that it does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians — gang operations are the place to try it. Focus levels up as you play ranges, golf, pool and fish, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away. The planes parked out on the airfield do not count — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge; the easiest is at terminals E3 and E4, reached through a fence gap with stairs beside the bridge. Board, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse onto the strip and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport before it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive in through the gate or over the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and fire at enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed back doors and marks jewelry stores with green icons. Enter through the back, use the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, find the safe-code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave quietly. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target. It pops shortly after you leave.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip to mark more security vans. Each vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and swap cars to lose the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults counts — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing the vault covers it. Or do it earlier in free-roam: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold at Ammu-Nation and in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is visible throughout. Start early and keep at it between missions, since unfogging also reveals the shops, races and collectibles other trophies need.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and the 100% checklist wants all 39 — so this pops naturally on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs. You only need one operation per gang for the trophy itself.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar with the view. That is the whole trophy — one drink, one view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack the car, drive forward through the glass, and keep going down the street — the pop is slightly delayed. Only this specific blue Banshee counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and blow the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all three in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for whatever you missed.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength (heart icon). It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Buy a fitness-club membership, always train together — call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle — and while one works out the other trains automatically, doubling progress. There are clubs all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes count as Professional, non-lethal takedowns as Hardened, kills as Violent, and mass carnage as Psycho. It accrues passively through robberies and fights across the whole game, so it usually pops on its own — if it is your last trophy, any profile-affecting action still counts. Avoid pushing the profile to Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes police far more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this one as unknown and believes it may relate to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description, Second time's the charm, suggests a repeat visit. Until a guide confirms it, do not chase it specially; check back after launch-week guides update, and keep a manual save from early in the game in case it turns out to be tied to the prologue.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. After 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back — the spawn is slightly random. When the car is there, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO in the sky, approach it, and it drops the woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this one as unknown and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The description, Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, points to knocking enemies down from a moving bike. Try melee attacks from a motorcycle against standing enemies in free-roam; until a guide confirms the exact trigger, treat it as unconfirmed and do not grind it blindly.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every shop type. The fastest route is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. Keep shopping as you play and it pops on its own; if it is your last one, buy the priciest weapon mods you have not got yet.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone. Buy them all through the app — $160,000 in total. There are 4 more story-related garages, but only the 8 purchasable ones count. Robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 are the quickest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need parking first, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) — each one adds spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register in his garage. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
